stages.title: Draft your story
stages.text: The draft improves as weeks pass. Consultants are optional.
stages.label: Develop for one week

stages.title: Secure your budget
stages.text: Open Film studio and pitch a producer, or use your own cash.
stages.label: Choose financing

stages.title: Build your team
stages.text: Choose your cast and crew, then confirm the package.
stages.label: Choose cast & crew

stages.title: Prepare the shoot
stages.text: Review location, permits and safety in Film studio. Then advance.
stages.label: Prepare for one week

stages.title: Keep the cameras rolling
stages.text: Check your spend and burnout. Each week uses production days.
stages.label: Shoot for one week

stages.title: Finish your edit
stages.text: Choose how much to polish the edit and check the audience rating.
stages.label: Edit for one week

stages.title: Build anticipation
stages.text: Set an affordable weekly campaign spend in Film studio.
stages.label: Promote for one week

stages.title: Choose opening night
stages.text: Book screens, select your date and consider rights offers.
stages.label: Plan the release

stages.title: Follow your opening
stages.text: Advance to see the next week’s tickets, reviews and producer income.
stages.label: Simulate box-office week

stages.title: Celebrate, then plan ahead
stages.text: Campaign for awards before archiving. Your catalog will keep earning.
stages.label: Archive & view filmography

glossary.text: All amounts use lakh BDT. 1 lakh = ৳100,000. Your personal cash is separate from a producer-financed film’s budget.
Gross is what audiences pay. Receipts are the producer’s share after cinema splits. Profit is receipts minus actual spending.
Your negotiated percentage of positive producer profit. You still receive your directing fee if a financed film loses money.
Next week moves production forward. Financing, casting and release require your decision. Automatic time pauses at these gates.
The game autosaves each week and when the app goes into the background. Use a manual slot before starting a different career.
Use Career to take paid advertising work, recover from burnout or arrange a bridge loan. A flop is not the end.
